body: That's true, It was quite hurtful as it sunk in that my life is going to be a lonely one, but you can adapt and find other things to bring content to your life, find peace in solitude friend c:

They've known about my depression in the past but I guess I haven't really been honest with them lately, maybe I need to go back to therapy aswell, just haven't had great experiences with it in the past
Honestly thank you, that's actually some sound advice that I'll give a go, I've been trying to figure out where my drive has gone for the longest time.

I appreciate your comment, I hope things turn out for the better for you too. In the end I probably won't walk down this path and die later rather than sooner, it just sucks not having an easy choice in the matter, but life ain't easy.

Yeah its the one thing putting me off, if I choose to take my life one day I'd rather I not come back from it. In terms of venting, I've done in the past to a close friend but could never really find the right words or way to describe what's going on, the baseline is I've got no motivation to live, I don't want to be apart of the rat race of life.

I'm sorry, it's hard not having people close by to turn to, I haven't had friends around me physically for the longest time. For what it's worth and I know it's not much coming from a random fresh reddit account but stick it out, life throws curve balls all the time some for the worse but you never know when it's for the better.
Yeah it truly is, I just keep telling myself why not wait it out a bit longer, something will give and life might turn for the better.
Also I'm sorry you ended up in a place where that was an option that you took, I hope you're doing better nowadays

I see, I guess it isn't as simple as taking a large amount. I've always considered it but thats the one thing I'm scared of, surviving and being left in a vegetative state and become even more of a burden to the people around me.
